description: Painted sprite for the patrol queen (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/patrol-queen.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the royal patrol QUEEN from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose and chunky proportions, not for its style or its wig shape. SUBJECT: a haughty royal queen. A towering powdered pale blue-white beehive wig, much taller than it is wide (about 1.3 times as tall as wide), built from stacked ridged rolls with bold dark ridge lines between them and a domed top, draped with two swags of gold beads and pearls hanging from a blue jewel at the front. A gold crown with five tall points and a blue gem sits on the very top of the wig, about half as wide as the wig. Under the wig a small steel cap over a clear round skin face, as wide as the cap, with two black dot eyes and small red lips. Behind her neck a tall stiff WHITE fan collar edged with a thin gold rim, opening out like a fan on both sides of her head (pure white with pale blue shading, not tan, not beige, not lace). A royal-blue gown: the bell skirt is solid royal blue all the way across the front, with NO vertical stripes, NO centre panel and NO gold on it except one gold hem band at the bottom; the bodice is royal blue with a narrow gold stomacher strip that stops at the waist. Big round puffed blue sleeves with gold stripes standing out wide at her shoulders, white gloves. A slim gold sceptre topped with a round blue jewelled orb and a small gold cross, held upright in her right fist on the right side of the figure: her gloved fist is clearly wrapped round the sceptre's rod, fingers visibly gripping it, and the orb rises to about the height of the wig's middle. The sceptre is thin, the orb no wider than her face. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the wig, crown and head together are about half the figure's height. EYES: two small black dot eyes painted into the round face, side by side, level, a little toward the right side of the face, clearly visible, no bigger than a fifth of the face width. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal and pearls, polished royal blue with gold trim. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
